messages.subject: Notes: leadership meeting, Wed 25 March
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Notes from today's leadership meeting:

Attendees: Marta, Dev, Helen, Priya, Tomás, Aisha, Lena

Discussed:
- v3 launch timing (still on track for the current plan)
- support load after the key rotation, Aisha's numbers look healthy
- SLA expectations for the Pro plan, prompted by Swiftbox's contract questions

Agreed:
- Pro customers get a first-response SLA of 2 business hours, effective with the v3 launch
- Standard plan keeps the current best-effort response, no formal SLA

Actions:
- Aisha: update the support playbook and staffing model to match
- Tomás: share the SLA terms with key accounts as contracts come up for renewal
- Lena: circulate these notes

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: Notes: leadership meeting, Wed 25 March
messages.body:
Hi team 😊

Thanks Lena, notes received and understood. Just so everyone knows what this means on my side: 2 business hours first response for Pro will need a small shift in the rota so the queue is watched continuously during business hours, and I'll fold that into the playbook this week. I'll also set up a monitoring alert so we can see how we're actually performing against it before we promise it too loudly anywhere.

Warmly,
Aisha

messages.subject: RE: Nordvik Logistics - SLA question
messages.body:
Hey Samir,

Exactly right, that's the standard Pro commitment now, reuse it wherever it helps close 🚀 Just keep me in cc on anything contract-shaped.

Saludos,
Tomás

messages.subject: RE: Discrepancy in the Pro first-response SLA - need to fix before it ships
messages.body:
Hola Aisha,

I'm certain it was 1 hour. We discussed it in the March leadership meeting, I remember it clearly because Carla's requirements were the whole reason it came up, and I put it in writing to her immediately afterwards. I would never have put a number in an email to a customer without it being agreed.

If the rota is built around 2 hours then honestly the rota should be adjusted - the commitment is the commitment.

Saludos,
Tomás

messages.subject: RE: Discrepancy in the Pro first-response SLA - need to fix before it ships
messages.body:
Hallo ihr beiden,

I went back to my notes from the 25 March meeting this morning. What I wrote down at the time, and what I circulated the same evening, was 2 business hours - I would not have invented that number, it came out of the discussion as I heard it. I don't remember anyone saying 1 hour, and nobody corrected the notes when I sent them, which is normally how we catch these things.

That said, Tomás is equally sure, and he has a customer email to point at, so arguing from memory is getting us nowhere. I suggest we put this to Marta with both versions side by side and let her say which one we honour - and importantly, what we tell Carla and Nordvik if the written promise was wrong. Until then I'd ask nobody to quote the SLA externally.

Lena
